ravi: Auditor asked for a compact evidence bundle: S3/EBS/RDS encryption-at-rest proof, KMS rotation history (Enable/Disable/ScheduleDeletion events), RBAC deltas for Q3-Q4 2024, and a one-paragraph incident triage for the Nov dependency vuln. Who can assemble and map to SOC2/ISO controls?

megan: I can run S3 bucket-encryption exports and KMS rotation queries. Confirming auditor wants 12 months of data. I'll also export CloudTrail for kms:EnableKeyRotation, ScheduleKeyDeletion, DisableKey.

tony: I'll handle EBS/RDS snapshot metadata and IAM change events (CreateRole, AttachRolePolicy, PutRolePolicy). I'll produce rbac_changes_q3q4.csv with eventId and actor.

megan: example commands i'll run:
aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket redwood-prod-backups > bucket_encryption.json
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id {} >> kms_rotation_status.json
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=EnableKeyRotation --start-time 2024-03-01 --end-time 2025-03-01 > kms_events.json

tony: quick highlights from IAM export: 2024-10-05 role svc-backup created by megan; 2024-11-20 svc-ingest received PutRolePolicy (s3:PutObject) removed 2024-12-02. I'll include event IDs for traceability.

auditor_elena: Please include sha256 hashes and a GPG-signed manifest with chain-of-custody lines (who exported which file and the export command). Also provide a control crosswalk mapping artifact -> SOC2/ISO refs (e.g., CC7/CC6, ISO A.10/A.9).

megan: Will bundle into sec-evidence-2025-03.tar.gz, sign with GPG key 0xC0FFEE, and upload via presigned S3 link (7d). ETA EOD Wed PST. Manifest will list file path, sha256, exportedBy, exportCommand, and cloudtrailEventIds.

export-bot: Ticket SEC-AUD-599 created, owner: megan, due: 2025-03-06, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-AUD-599

ravi: Thanks — ping @auditor_elena when uploaded and we'll close the loop.
